name: Rhoda, Geist Avenger
oracle_text:
Partner with Timin, Youthful Geist (When this creature enters, target player may put Timin into their hand from their library, then shuffle.)
Vigilance
Whenever a creature an opponent controls becomes tapped, if it isn't being declared as an attacker, put a +1/+1 counter on Rhoda.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a creature an opponent controls becomes tapped, if it isn't being declared as an attacker, put a +1/+1 counter on Rhoda.

needs.what: a `becomes_tapped` trigger that can exclude taps caused by the creature being declared as an attacker (508.1f): the TAPPED event fired by the attack declaration must carry a marker (e.g. `cause: "attack_declaration"`) and the trigger needs a key such as `not_attack_declaration: true` to filter on it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `becomes_tapped` maps to EventType.TAPPED, which `primitives.tap_permanent` fires with only player/source/oid, so an attack-declaration tap is indistinguishable from a tap for mana, a tap-cost or a `tap` op; trigger_keys (`not_cause`, `cause_controller`, `filter`) and `step_is` cannot tell them apart (a creature can be tapped for other reasons during the declare-attackers step), so the unfiltered trigger would wrongly grow Rhoda whenever an opponent attacks with a non-vigilant creature
